overviewHtml:
Agentic workloads are hard to reason about because behavior is spread across prompt flows, tool calls and downstream services.

What you get

  • Demos for model SDKs such as AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI and Mistral
  • Demos for frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK and LiteLLM
  • Setup guides for coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex CLI
  • Examples using OneAgent, OpenTelemetry or an OTel Collector
getStartedHtml:
You need a Dynatrace environment and an AI workload to instrument.

  1. Pick your SDK or framework from the demo tables
  2. Choose OneAgent, OpenTelemetry or a Collector
  3. Follow that folder's example and check the traces
